// @path: src/app/ops/page.tsx
// @expect: OPS-MEDIA-ELEMENT
// The same element without the angle brackets.
import { createElement } from "react";
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";
import { latest } from "@/lib/ops/reads";

export default async function OpsHome() {
  await requireOperator();
  const p = await latest();
  return createElement("img", { src: p.path });
}
